jobs.name: tile-plaza
jobs.prompt: Stylized 3D game asset: a single square modular ground tile for a tile-based isometric city, isometric three-quarter view from above, isolated on a pure black background. A thick square block exactly as wide as it is deep, perfectly flat top surface, straight vertical sides with a thin bevelled top edge, so identical tiles sit side by side seamlessly. TOP: dark violet cobblestone pavers in a herringbone pattern, a few thin glowing hot-orange inlay strips, a small drain grate, light wear. SIDES: layered dark violet stone. Chunky toy-like proportions with bevelled edges like Monument Valley, clean readable silhouette. Night 'Neon Dusk' palette: deep violet and dark gunmetal (#2a1650, #1b1838), glowing neon accents in hot orange (#ff6a3d) and magenta pink (#ff4fa3) with small cyan (#4fd8ff) highlights. No text, no letters, no logos, no people.
